text:
mira singh: FYI starting a tiny canary for v6-int4 tonight. noticed many low-signal drops across slices that individually pass thresholds but look bad in the aggregate. thinking of an entropy-weighted gate that penalizes regressions more when they occur across diverse slices, not just high-traffic ones. any concerns?

dylan cho: interesting. how do you compute entropy here?

mira singh: compute slice distribution over traffic and use Shannon entropy H=-sum(p_i log p_i). then scale each slice's delta by a diversity weight w_i = 1 + lambda * (1 - p_i/H_norm) so rarer slices get a boost. aggregate = sum(w_i * traffic_i * max(0, delta_i)). trigger if aggregate > T.

nora wu: I like biasing toward diverse slices. small ask: include business importance multiplier so we don't over-prioritize obscure slices that aren't revenue-critical.

mira singh: yup composite weight = traffic * importance * (1 + lambda * diversity_boost). importance comes from model-registry tags.

kai brown: operationally: prefer p90 deltas, cap each slice's contribution to avoid single outliers, and add cooldown/hysteresis. Also, add an option to convert latency wins into negative aggregate (credit).

dylan cho: sketch config (pseudo):

```
policy: entropy-weighted-aggregate
window_minutes: 20
quantile: 90
lambda: 2.0               # diversity boost strength
per_slice_cap: 0.025      # 2.5% max per slice
importance_source: registry
latency_credit_factor: 0.6
trigger_threshold: 0.02   # 2% aggregate
cooldown_minutes: 20
```

nora wu: can you run a backtest against last 90 days and compare this to the plain weighted-sum policy? I'd like to see false-trigger delta and which slices the new policy surfaces.

mira singh: on it. quick note: infra, can the metrics pipeline return per-slice traffic distribution at 30s granularity? need it to compute live entropy. @infra-bot

infra-bot: metrics: per-slice traffic_shares and deltas exported every 30s to metrics-store. can add a 10s export for rollout watchers if requested.

kai brown: also add a "conservative mode" toggle for enterprise customers that multiplies threshold by 1.5 and increases per-slice cap.

dylan cho: logging: emit top-5 diversity contributors, signed_aggregate, absolute_aggregate, and config_hash on any trigger. store full timeseries for 14 days for audits.

nora wu: backtest results: with lambda=2 and trigger=2% over last 90 days, false-trigger rate drops vs plain weighted-sum (0.3% -> 0.18% weekly) and surfaces three low-traffic but high-importance slices we missed before. attaching charts to ticket ML-8210.

mira singh: great. i'll draft a small PR adding the policy to rollout-service and include partial fallback: 30% -> 70% -> full. will include kai's conservative toggle and dylan's logging.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary start=1778004000 for v6-int4. health checks: p90 latency, error-rate, entropy-weighted-aggregate. partial-fallback enabled.

kai brown: UX note: we should display an "entropy impact" bar in the rollout UI showing contribution from distribution vs traffic to help reviewers understand why obscure slices triggered action.

mira singh: good UX idea. nora, can you validate sim results and sign off on thresholds?

nora wu: will review now and post a signoff comment in ML-8210 by EOD.

dylan cho: one more thought  consider a combined gate: min(entropy-weighted, traffic-weighted) to avoid gaming. but let's ship the single policy first and iterate.

mira singh: agreed. thanks all. i'll ping the channel when the canary completes. :rocket:
